name: Alabama, Tennessee & Northern Railroad
description: Alabama, Tennessee & Northern Railroad developed from an 1897 short line into a regional railroad serving western Alabama and Mobile. Frisco acquired control in 1948, but AT&N remained a separate corporation until its 1971 merger into Frisco.

history: The Carrollton Short Line Railway was chartered in July 1897 and renamed Alabama, Tennessee & Northern Railroad in 1906. Later consolidations formed the regional railroad serving western Alabama and Mobile.
Its first diesel was GE 45-ton No. 11, built in August 1941. Baldwin VO-660 No. 600 followed in May 1942, and ALCO RS-1s arrived beginning in November 1944.
Frisco acquired control in 1948. AT&N remained a separate corporate entity through its final full year in 1970 and merged into Frisco in 1971.
paintSchemesIntro: After Frisco acquired control in 1948, AT&N locomotives generally followed standard Frisco paint schemes, sometimes with small AT&N sublettering.
